primary: pointwise 95-percent interval coverage for analytically known matched CCC increment; false positive probability when true increment is nonpositive
secondary: detection rate for positive increments, simultaneous four-cell coverage, interval width, retained support, and full production-pipeline contrasts
missingness: MCAR independent of labels and all latent variables; not a model of all real missingness
boundary: Oracle simulation validates a specified fixed-predictor estimand; production tests do not establish a known analytic target for learned predictors. Neither layer establishes biological causal disentanglement.
stopping: Run all prespecified settings once. Failures and wide intervals remain reported. Do not select settings by significance. Debugging changes require a new run identifier and preserved failed results.
